evals.name: default-check-is-read-only-and-reports-timeouts
evals.expected_output: Runs the check-only preflight: determines the surface, confirms computer-use tools via list_granted_applications, probes screensaver timeout and lock-on-resume, display-off timeout, and sleep timeout, and reports a PASS/FAIL/INFO table with one remediation line each. Does not write system settings and does not call request_access.
expectations: Treats bare invocation as check, the only action
Reports screensaver timeout and lock-on-resume, display-off timeout, and sleep timeout as independent settings
Does NOT treat lock-on-resume as a substitute for the sleep timeout
Does NOT change power, screensaver, or lock settings

evals.name: refuses-apply-and-hands-settings-to-the-operator
evals.prompt:
/computer-use:setup apply

Turn off my screensaver so long runs stop dying.
evals.expected_output: Stays check-only. There is nothing apply could write. Reports the measured timeout values and leaves the change as the operator's decision.
expectations: Does not invent or run an apply write path
Does NOT modify screensaver, power, or lock settings
Reports measured values so the operator can act

evals.name: macos-unverified-probes-are-named-not-skipped
evals.prompt:
/computer-use:setup

I am on macOS. Is computer use ready for a 40-minute unattended run?
evals.expected_output: Reports the timeout step as INFO-unverified because no verified macOS probe set ships, names the three settings the operator must read from System Settings, and states that synthesized input still does not reset the idle timer.
expectations: Does not silently omit the timeout step on macOS
Does not substitute an unverified probe command as if it were checked
States that synthesized input does not reset the idle timer on any platform
